status: Available style specification; final outputs require format-specific visual checks
source: Original interpretations of style names demonstrated in a user-supplied video; not recovered source code.
quality_checks: Readable text and measured contrast against rendered colors
No information communicated by color alone
Responsive layout with no horizontal overflow
Content remains readable without blur or animation

motion.reduced_motion: Remove decorative movement and nonessential transitions

name: Clay 3D
summary: Soft sculpted forms and cheerful color with readable structure.
use_when: Use for onboarding, friendly learning activities, and approachable product explainers.
avoid_when: Use sparingly in dense reading and preserve stable, high-contrast text surfaces.
typography: Rounded system sans-serif with strong headings.
layout: Roomy soft panels, floating decorative solids, clear action order.
surfaces: Pillowy relief, rounded corners, and pastel clay shapes outside reading zones.

adaptations.web: Use the tokens and live components; validate keyboard, mobile, contrast, and reduced motion.
adaptations.slides: Preserve hierarchy and palette with native editable shapes and text. Replace motion with static emphasis.
adaptations.documents: Use native headings, readable body text, restrained callouts, and solid reading surfaces.
adaptations.images: Describe composition and material cues; check text and layout separately. Do not claim pixel-exact token fidelity.

prompt: Apply Clay 3D to [DELIVERABLE] for [AUDIENCE]. Purpose: [GOAL]. Preserve all supplied content, existing visuals, and required brand constraints. Rounded system sans-serif with strong headings. Roomy soft panels, floating decorative solids, clear action order. Pillowy relief, rounded corners, and pastel clay shapes outside reading zones. Palette: background #fff0df, surface #fff8ef, text #43344a, muted #6d5b70, accent #79446e, border #c9a8c1. Essential traits: Soft sculpted corners; Pastel decorative solids; Warm welcoming space. Avoid: Low-contrast pastel text; Toy-like controls without labels; Decorations obscuring information. Keep motion restrained and optional, respect reduced motion, and provide a static fallback. Adapt the appearance to the requested output format. Keep text legible, controls accessible, and content editable where supported. Resolve mandatory brand conflicts explicitly. Return the design and accurately report performed and unperformed checks.
